scraped_title: Land plot for sale in Almoçageme - Penedo
description_text: Located in the center of the picturesque village of Almoçageme, in Colares, we find this unique project. The plot is characterized by abundant vegetation, providing a bucolic and lush environment. The entire project is designed to ensure this natural vegetation coexists with the new construction.The mixed plot, both urban and rustic, is in the process of submitting the Prior Information Request (PIP) to the CMS. With a total area of 386 square meters, the project includes the construction of a single-story house and a pool and exterior support area.All the private areas of the residence are located on the ground floor, featuring 4 en-suite bedrooms and a social area with a living and dining room, an open-concept kitchen, and a laundry room. Although the residential area is entirely on one floor, there is a semi-underground second floor with a common area for leisure activities, divided into zones with spa and gym functions. This floor is at the level of the pool and the entire deck area, enjoying the best landscape environment with a privileged west-facing orientation. It is noteworthy that the project presents a set of strategically positioned volumes to create a clear connection between the interior and exterior, inviting natural light to flow through the spaces. In the circulation volume, an empty space functions as an interior courtyard where the stairs to the flat roof are located.Located in the center of the picturesque village of Almoçageme, this land is just 5 minutes from Adraga Beach, 7 minutes from Praia Grande, and 40 minutes from Lisbon International Airport. It is 13 km from the Carlucci American International School of Lisbon and the TASIS Portugal International School.This project is an excellent opportunity for various purposes: a single-family home, a holiday house, or an investment in local accommodation, due to its privileged location.

scraped_title: Land plot for sale in Avenida 10 de Agosto, 124
description_text: Land with 2 fronts in Santa Susana next to Sociedade Recreativa.According to the PDM of Sintra is located in low-density urban spaces. What the PDM of Sintra says:" Low-density urban spaces?Low-density urban spaces correspond to partially urbanized and built up areas, presenting fragmentation and hybrid characteristics of an urban-rural occupation, with the permanence of agricultural uses intertwined with urban uses and the existence of equipment and infrastructures, and for which a land use regime is established that guarantees their planning in a perspective of sustainability and flexibility of use? 93. Contrary to what occurs in the areas included in the categories of central and residential spaces, the provisions for determining the concrete edibility of the category of low-density urban spaces begin to define parameters and indicators, mainly for the following reasons: a) The urban-rural character of the occupation, which should translate into a less intense land use and a transition between rustic and urban soil; (b) the need to fix a minimum plot area avoiding excessive reparcelling of the soil; c) Existing buildings, even if with greater use in some cases, are safeguarded by the regulation of the Plan. Thus, without prejudice to the special regimes applicable, the general provisions of this Regulation, the concrete edibility is that resulting from the cumulative fulfillment of the following conditions94: a) The fractionation of buildings with a size of less than 500 m2 is not allowed; (b) the maximum utilisation index (Iu) shall be 0,20; (c) the minimum permeability index shall be 0,50; d) The height of the building (H) shall not exceed seven (7) meters, and may assume punctually and based on the modal value, a height of nine (9) meters, not being allowed in this case the use of recessed floors and the use of attic; e) Maximum number of two floors above the threshold level. Although the minimum plot area, for reparcelling purposes, is 500 m2, a significant use of the soil will only be achieved from the 1,000 m2 of land targeted by the urban operation, which is achieved through the maximum use index (Iu) adopted (0.2). On the other hand, the maximum number of floors (2) is fixed, assuming that the height of the building (H) may be higher, if the modal value so determines. Finally, a minimum permeability index of 0.5 is established, which ensures that at least half of the terrain is not waterproofed. It should be noted that this is a category of urban land, and as such, associated with a more intensive human use, which justifies in most cases an impermeable area above the maximum use index (Iu), namely for circulation and leisure within the lot or plot (playing fields, swimming pools, among others).".
